statement.zh-TW: 能用會計恆等式（資產＝負債＋股東權益）檢查一張資產負債表是否平衡，並在不平衡時判斷少了哪一邊的數字
statement.en: Use the accounting equation (assets = liabilities + equity) to check whether a balance sheet balances, and work out which side is missing a figure when it does not

text.zh-TW: 以為資產總計要等於負債總額
text.en: Thinking total assets should equal total liabilities

text.zh-TW: 以為左右合計相等就代表表上每個數字都對
text.en: Thinking that equal totals on both sides mean every figure on the sheet is right

text.zh-TW: 把資產總計當成公司帳上的現金
text.en: Treating total assets as the cash the company has in the bank

text.zh-TW: 以為花錢買東西之後資產總計一定變少
text.en: Thinking total assets must fall whenever cash is spent

statement.zh-TW: 能把科目分到資產、負債與股東權益，並依一年內會不會變現或到期分出流動與非流動
statement.en: Sort accounts into assets, liabilities and equity, and split them into current and non-current by whether they turn into cash or fall due within a year

text.zh-TW: 因為名字裡有「帳款」，就把應付帳款當成資產
text.en: Treating trade payables as an asset because the name sounds like receivables

text.zh-TW: 以為一年後才到期的借款也是流動負債，因為它遲早要還
text.en: Thinking a loan due in more than a year is still a current liability because it must be repaid eventually

text.zh-TW: 以為設備可以賣掉變現，所以是流動資產
text.en: Thinking equipment is a current asset because it could be sold for cash

text.zh-TW: 把股本當成公司欠股東的負債
text.en: Treating share capital as a debt the company owes its shareholders

statement.zh-TW: 能說明本期淨利怎麼經由未分配盈餘留在資產負債表上，並判斷一筆交易會不會動到未分配盈餘
statement.en: Explain how profit for the period stays on the balance sheet through unappropriated retained earnings, and judge whether a transaction changes it

text.zh-TW: 以為本期淨利結帳之後就從帳上消失了
text.en: Thinking profit for the period disappears from the books once the period is closed

text.zh-TW: 以為只要有現金進來，未分配盈餘就會增加
text.en: Thinking any transaction that brings in cash raises unappropriated retained earnings

text.zh-TW: 以為發放現金股利是一筆費用，會讓本期淨利變少
text.en: Thinking a cash dividend is an expense that lowers profit for the period

statement.zh-TW: 能分辨股本與未分配盈餘的來源：一個是股東投入的錢，一個是公司自己賺來還沒分出去的錢
statement.en: Tell share capital from unappropriated retained earnings by where each comes from: money the shareholders put in, and profit the company earned and has not yet distributed

text.zh-TW: 以為公司賺到的錢會加到股本
text.en: Thinking the profit a company earns is added to share capital

text.zh-TW: 以為未分配盈餘是一筆放在銀行、隨時可以領出來的現金
text.en: Thinking unappropriated retained earnings are a pile of cash in the bank ready to be withdrawn

text.zh-TW: 以為股東增資會讓未分配盈餘增加
text.en: Thinking a new capital injection from shareholders raises unappropriated retained earnings

text.zh-TW: 以為收回以前的應收帳款是公司新賺到的錢
text.en: Thinking collecting an old receivable is new profit

statement.zh-TW: 能算出流動比率，說明它問的是「一年內能變現的資產，夠不夠付一年內到期的帳」，並知道沒有流動負債時顯示 N/A
statement.en: Work out the current ratio, explain that it asks whether the assets that turn into cash within a year can cover the bills due within a year, and know that it shows N/A when there are no current liabilities

text.zh-TW: 用資產總計除以負債總額當作流動比率
text.en: Using total assets divided by total liabilities as the current ratio

text.zh-TW: 以為流動比率越高一定越好
text.en: Thinking a higher current ratio is always better

text.zh-TW: 流動負債為零時把流動比率寫成 0
text.en: Writing the current ratio as 0 when there are no current liabilities

text.zh-TW: 以為流動比率高於一倍時，借一筆一年內要還的錢可以把它拉高
text.en: Thinking that, with a current ratio above one, a loan due within a year will raise it
